### [M-02] Unrecoverable Buyer Pot Lock and Unbacked Winner Claim in `Raffle::_settleWinningTicket` Because `Status.NftWon` Settlement Zeroes `unsettledPot` Without Verifying Prize Deliverability or Providing a Refund Fallback

**Severity:** Medium
**Location:** [packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L533-L558](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L533-L558)

**Preconditions:**
- Internal: Raffle resolves to `Status.NftWon` (`totalEntries >= reserveEntries` at [packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L521](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L521)).
- External: `prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), winner, deliveredPrizeTokenId)` at [packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L334](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L334) reverts or fails to transfer ownership when `from == address(raffle)` (due to an untrusted/malicious `prizeToken` per [DESIGN.md](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/DESIGN.md), a collection-level pause, or an `ERC721C` transfer validator blocking contract senders).

**Attack path:**
1. Starting state: Raffle #1 is created with `reserveEntries = 100`, and honest buyers purchase 100 entries for `100,000,000` raw USDC (`100 USDC`), setting `unsettledPot = 100,000,000`.
2. After `endTime`, `requestDraw()` and `fulfillRandomWords()` set `status = Status.NftWon` and `winningEntry` in `[1, 100]` ([packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L518-L523](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L518-L523)).
3. Any caller invokes [`Raffle::settleWinningTicket`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L304), which executes [`_settleWinningTicket`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L533-L558).
4. `_settleWinningTicket` sets `unsettledPot = 0`, `sponsorProceeds = 95,000,000`, `protocolFees = 5,000,000`, and `settlementComplete = true` at [packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L551-L555](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L551-L555) without touching `prizeToken`.
5. Consequence: When [`redeemWinningTicket`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L309-L338) reverts at `prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), winner, deliveredPrizeTokenId)`, [`enableRefunds`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L293) also reverts with `InvalidStatus(Status.NftWon)`, and `unsettledPot` has already been converted into `sponsorProceeds` and `protocolFees`.

**Mitigation:**
- Option A: In `Status.NftWon`, only execute `_settleWinningTicket` (converting `unsettledPot` into `sponsorProceeds` and `protocolFees`) inside `redeemWinningTicket` after `prizeToken.transferFrom(address(this), winner, deliveredPrizeTokenId)` and `prizeToken.ownerOf(deliveredPrizeTokenId) == winner` succeed at [packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L334-L337](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L334-L337).
- Option B: Add a post-resolution redemption timeout after `resolvedAt` in [`Raffle::enableRefunds`](file:///Users/hishamel-husseini/.codex/visualizations/2026/10/21/01a15d64-4430-7440-b259-192acf9762b5/raffle-audit-r001/runtime/gemini-native-repairs/SIMAO/attempt-02/work/packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol#L276) that allows transitioning from `Status.NftWon` to `Status.Refunding` if `!settlementComplete` (or if `prizeClaimed == false` while keeping `sponsorProceeds` and `protocolFees` locked until `prizeClaimed == true`).
